about: Public live streams the organs have been tried on (2026-09-30). Live content changes, so a horizon is labelled per capture (bench.py label), not here; 'expect' is what the scene usually shows. Frames are captured into media/worlds/ (gitignored): they are other people's footage, not ours to republish.

streams.name: tram
streams.expect: a tram cab's view down the tracks; by day the organ reads it within 0.01; at night windscreen reflections scatter it
